description: SMB incident first-response guide — playbooks + threat stats. First-hour playbooks for the incidents small businesses actually suffer — ransomware, business email compromise/payment fraud, account takeover, lost device, suspected POS compromise — each with ordered first steps, a do-not list, what evidence to preserve and who to contact, plus the sourced SMB threat statistics (Verizon DBIR 2025) that explain why. Defensive only. $0.1 USDC on Base. Returns the x402 URL to GET (402 → PAYMENT-SIGNATURE → delivery). Free to call this tool; payment happens on the URL.
